correctness.rationale: The tensor projectors for the two complete-graph Laplacians have joint eigenvalues 0,p,q,p+q and give the four entry classes. Exact symbolic replay with python3 /workspace/checks/rk4_algebra.py verified A=h f, A−B, C, both quadratic discriminants, 3ac−b², and the fixed-sum derivative and its discriminant. For h>0, B>A and C>0; the scalar RK4 polynomial is positive on the nonpositive real axis by the exponential Taylor remainder, giving positive diagonals. The positive certificate 3ac−b² forces f′<0, giving a single crossing, A=0 at H and A<0 thereafter, with stochastic row sums where all entries are nonnegative. At fixed N=p+q, the derivative quadratic has positive leading term and negative discriminant bounded away from zero by the endpoint p=N/2 estimates, hence f grows with p at every h>0 and its zero moves strictly right. In the scaled limit N→∞ and p/N→r, dividing the derivative certificate by N⁴ leaves at least the strictly positive term 36(1−r)⁴ in 144(3ac−b²)/N⁴, so the limiting cubic is strictly decreasing and compact-interval convergence brackets the limiting root. The Euler-endpoint polynomial in I−hL verifies the strict improvement. 'Fixed-vertex-count' in the proof heading is a wording slip: the theorem and calculation fix p+q (degree plus two), not pq. The supplied verifier was inspected, not executed.
